column1: # P0c-39：窄链首段失败页关窗出口 —— 25084 指纹故意重冻（前后对照）。
# p0c-39: the narrow chain leading-stage fail-page close exit — 25084's fingerprint
# deliberately re-frozen, with the before/after pair.
# 起因 / cause：契约门（翻转后复跑，续片 15 判例）在 25084 上留下一条真缺陷：
#   BUTTON_WITHOUT_ROUTE|25084|started|804925|39|10001|1008
# 25084 的接取 NPC（DF5_Zake_E）≠ 首段检查 NPC（DF5_Coli_E）：39 失败边停在源节点 started 并显示
# 失败页 10001，而该页唯一的 FINISH_DIALOG(1008) 按钮在 started 上没有同键路由（探针 candidates=0）；
# 成功页（10000）的出口由落点节点 s1 补（既有 landedNpc 分支），失败页停在源节点，此前无人补。
# The contract gate (re-run after every flip, the 续片-15 rule) left one real defect on 25084: the
# accept npc (DF5_Zake_E) differs from the leading check npc (DF5_Coli_E), so the 39 fail edge stays on
# the started node with the fail page 10001, whose only FINISH_DIALOG(1008) button had no same-key
# route there (probe candidates=0). The ok page's exit comes from the landed node (the existing
# landedNpc branch); the fail page stays on the source node and nothing covered it.
# 修复 / fix：collectCheck 增加 sourceNeedsClose（= index 0 且检查 NPC ≠ 接取 NPC，或本行无接取 NPC）：
#   在源节点补 FINISH_DIALOG → CloseDialog 同键路由；检查 NPC 与接取 NPC 相同时 acceptFlow 已发出该
#   出口（25023 形，探针候选命中 SHOW_SELECTION_PAGE），不重复发；index > 0 的段由段循环发出。
# collectCheck gains sourceNeedsClose (= leading stage with a check npc other than the accept npc, or no
# accept npc at all): a same-key FINISH_DIALOG -> CloseDialog route on the source node. An identical
# accept npc already owns that exit via acceptFlow (the 25023 shape, whose probe candidate matched
# SHOW_SELECTION_PAGE), and stages past the first are covered by the stage loop.
# 影响面 / blast radius：仅 25084 一行指纹变化（其余 1120 冻结行零漂移，见 p0c-37 同批 dump 对比）；
# 同级 25023（接取 NPC = 检查 NPC）与 15613（首段为 talk）不变。
# Only 25084's fingerprint moved (the other 1120 frozen rows: zero drift); 25023 (accept npc == check
# npc) and 15613 (talk-first) are unchanged.
